caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic mug that is centrally placed on a plain light beige or off-white background. The mug has a cylindrical shape with a slightly wider top than bottom and a rounded handle attached to its right side. The color of the mug is predominantly dark brown with lighter brown and reddish highlights that suggest light reflection on a glazed surface. The inside of the mug and its rim also display a similar range of brown tones. The composition is minimal, with no additional objects included, and the mug appears to be floating in the center of a large blank rectangular area. There is a faint rectangular border framing the mug, and the name "N. Amantea" is written in small, neat letters in the lower right corner inside the border.
title: Mug
